description: This file is a shell script used within the OpenWrt build environment. It provides functionality to automate the process of bumping kernel versions in platform-specific directories, managing git operations, and handling associated configuration files. It includes functions for usage instructions, requirement checks, cleanup, and main execution flow, primarily to support kernel version updates while maintaining git history.

methods.name: _msg
methods.description: Outputs a message with a specified level (error, warning, notice) to standard error.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Resets traps and switches back to the initial git branch if changed.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the script, checks repository state, and sets up variables.

methods.name: bump_kernel
methods.description: Performs the kernel version bump by renaming relevant files and performing git operations.

methods.name: check_requirements
methods.description: Verifies the presence of required commands for the script to operate.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution entry point, parses arguments, performs checks, and orchestrates the bump process.
